generate_colormap_random_colors: generate a list of N random RGB color tuples using a fixed random seed
generate_colormap_custom_seed: generate a colormap with N equidistant colors by setting a custom seed value
make_visualization_tome_groups: create a visualization image from a PIL image and torch tensor showing ToMe patch groups
make_visualization_custom_patch_size: create a visualization with a custom patch size for ToMe attention merging groups
make_visualization_no_class_token: create a visualization image without skipping the class token in the source tensor
